text: At a mixer with friends, Yoko Okazaki misses a call from her own number and hears her own voice, dated two days ahead, say that it is starting to rain before a scream. Two days later [she dies just as the message foretold|rules|death sends warnings], and her phone [dials the next number by itself|wants|spreading and taking over]. As her friend Yumi Nakamura and a grieving detective trace [the curse|threat|witchcraft and cursed things] to an abandoned hospital, they find a red jawbreaker in each victim's mouth and [a mother suspected of harming her own children|wrong|harm done to children].
